name: City
description: Former survivor of Duskmourn, strongest forager of the carnival, who joined the Cult of Valgavoth and betrayed the carnival to the House.

timeline.summary: The group reaches a ridge and sees a barrier-shielded city of obelisks and temples on a river.
timeline.quote: all of which formed a sprawling city that spanned as far as we could see.

citation.work: Impact
citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decides to descend toward the city and its barrier.

citation.work: Impact
citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Dawn sees the foragers returning and runs to meet them.
timeline.quote: Delight washed through her and she jumped down

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Dawn notes Rill's wounded arm, Sunset's limp and City's unharmed state, which she finds suspicious.
timeline.quote: it wasn't right for two members of a raiding team to come back injured when the third looked completely fine

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Rill describes an ambush in a cold room and Sunset reveals the attackers were wickerfolk, which the detectors were not keyed for.
timeline.quote: Our detectors weren't keyed for wickerfolk.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: City, urging the others to hurry, tells Dawn that things have changed and that Duskmourn can now hunt.
timeline.quote: And now, Duskmourn can do what we've been doing all along.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: City reveals a tabard with a moth's wings and invites Dawn to join the Cult of Valgavoth, serving the Devouring Father.
timeline.quote: There's still a place for those of us who wish to serve the Devouring Father, among the Cult of Valgavoth.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In the dream, City looms from the woods, saying the Devouring Father is still hungry.
timeline.quote: The Devouring Father is still hungry

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: City, outside the door, tells Dawn he asked the Devouring Father to spare her and invites her to the Valley of Serenity.
timeline.quote: I asked him for your life, and he granted it to me

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Benefactors take her wand to install fresh batteries and Dawn feels safe, though City's words echo.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: House has swallowed the greater sun after sprouting from a city and growing across the world.
timeline.quote: According to the ones who'd managed to escape the city's grasp, it had been a house in the beginning

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The elf king admits city refugees on condition they leave their machines behind.
timeline.quote: No machines. None of your clever creations.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: City, Rill and Sunset return from a run where Rill was hurt by a Wickerfolk; City reveals he joined the Cult of Valgavoth, betraying the carnival.
timeline.quote: he revealed that He had aligned himself with Duskmourn and joined the Cult of Valgavoth

citation.work: City
citation.text: "City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: City tracks Dawn to an attic safe zone and has Razorkin kill everyone but her, offering her a choice to join him.
timeline.quote: He set his Razorkin on the camp, killing everyone but Dawn

citation.work: City
citation.text: "City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Reveals he serves the Devouring Father.
relations.quote: Beneath it he wore a tabard embroidered with the wings of a vast and colorful moth.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

relations.quote: those of us who wish to serve the Devouring Father

citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

relations.quote: Dawn was the only one who stumbled back, away from the suddenly menacing shape of her friend.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

relations.note: Calls himself the Devouring Father's most beloved new acolyte.
relations.quote: our Devouring Father doing a glorious favor for his most beloved new acolyte

citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.
